_comment: Coverage map for the ADTC agriculture corpus. Breadth is the hedge against 3 unknown hidden prompts. Each topic is crossed with several question forms so the model generalises across phrasing rather than memorising pairs. See SPEC.md.

question_forms.what: Definition or explanation of a concept, crop, or condition.
question_forms.diagnose: Farmer describes symptoms, model identifies likely cause and next step. The single most common real question.
question_forms.howto: Step by step procedure for a task.
question_forms.when: Timing and calendar, tied to season and agro-ecological zone.
question_forms.compare: Choosing between two options given a constraint like cost or soil.
question_forms.prevent: Avoiding a problem before it happens.
question_forms.economics: Cost, margin, input decisions, market timing.
question_forms.improve: Raising yield or quality from a described current state.

agro_ecological_zones: Sahel savanna (far north, ~250-500mm rain, short single season)
Guinea savanna (middle belt, ~1000-1400mm, long single season)
Humid forest (south, ~1500-2500mm, bimodal, early and late seasons)
Coastal and mangrove (very high rainfall, flooding risk)

key_points: ridge vs flat planting by drainage
weed control in first 3 months is decisive
75cm x 25cm spacing, one plant per stand
open pollinated vs hybrid seed tradeoff
seed yam setts and minisett technique
upland vs lowland vs irrigated systems
drought tolerance for Sudan and Sahel zones
flower thrips and pod borer timing
blossom end rot from calcium and irregular water
onion bulb curing and storage losses

pidgin._comment: Drawn from the slices above, asked and answered in Nigerian Pidgin. Never used to answer an English question.

general_replay._comment: Guards against catastrophic forgetting. Ordinary instruction following so the model keeps its manners when a judge phrases a hidden prompt conversationally or asks something slightly outside agriculture.
